subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: a contract author clearing inverse coverage — vector: adds a live design that `Serves` every Must with an empty or substanceless body
intent: coverage passes on a design that says nothing; a hollow contract enters planning
fit_criterion: **honestly residual in v1**: the mechanical gate checks that a live design *serves* each Must (FR-3), not whether it has substance; catching the substanceless design is the LLM follow-up's adequacy judgment (WR-1). The **same present-but-substanceless residual applies to FR-5's structural check** — a bogus fit criterion or a verification method that names no real proof passes field-presence; the whole mechanical/semantic boundary is the follow-up's (WR-1, NG-2). The residual is named here, not hidden; until WR-1, `clean` means "mechanically clean" and reviewers are told so (FR-7)
